source: Thomas approved the proposed transfers for German 7 Realschule, French 6 Gymnasium and Natur und Technik 7 Gymnasium (Informatics) in the Codex chat for ZAM 0.67.0 on 2026-11-21: “Alle sieben vorgeschlagenen Übernahmen freigeben und die drei Kurse einbinden”.

rows.reason: The same atomic retrieval is preserved: Präsens as the basic tense for an Inhaltsangabe, with Perfekt for anteriority.
The old prompt combines five summary criteria, the TATTE formula and drafting a Basissatz for Borchert's 'Die Kirschen'. No single new item preserves the complete multi-part retrieval.
The same atomic retrieval is preserved: why the ballad is unique as a synthesis of Epik, Lyrik and Dramatik.
The old prompt combines analysing epic, lyric and dramatic features in 'Erlkönig' and 'John Maynard' with Volksballade vs. Kunstballade. New items separate these aspects.
The same atomic retrieval is preserved: verb-final position of the finite verb in an introduced subordinate clause.
The old prompt combines Parataxe/Hypotaxe definitions, ADUSO punctuation rules and parsing two compound sentences. New lessons separate structure, pronominal adverbs and commas.
The old prompt tests Konzessivsatz ('obwohl/obgleich/obschon'), whereas Grade 7 LehrplanPLUS 4.2.4 focuses on Kausal-, Temporal-, Modal-, Lokal- and Attributsatz; no identical new card exists.
The old prompt requires systematising six adverbial-clause types and classifying three sentences together; the new curriculum splits causal/temporal and modal/local/attributive clauses.
The same atomic retrieval is preserved: the meaningful dieses, jenes oder welches replacement test for 'das'.
The old prompt combines full grammatical explanations of 'das'/'dass' with solving five blanks across two sentences. New items keep the replacement test and punctuation traps separate.
